top_signals.title: European Stocks Drop as Bonds Sell Off Globally and Oil Climbs
top_signals.summary: European stocks retreated for a second day as oil prices spiked and global bonds sold off, with the average yield rising to levels not seen for almost two decades.

top_signals.title: Westwood CEO Says Texas ETF Listing Aligns With Business
top_signals.summary: Brian Casey, chief executive officer of Dallas-based Westwood Holdings Group Inc., says the decision to list a new exchange-traded fund on the Texas Stock Exchange makes sense because the power-generation ETF is focused on Texas. He speaks with Bloomberg's Julie Fine about the ETF, the future of the TXSE and how artificial-intelligence regulation affects technology stocks. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: David Booth on Investing, Dimensional and Staying Calm | The David Rubenstein Show
top_signals.summary: David Booth started Dimensional Fund Advisors out of a Brooklyn brownstone in 1981 with an idea that challenged conventional investing: investors should have exposure to smaller companies as part of a diversified portfolio. Today, Dimensional manages more than $1 trillion. Booth sits down with David Rubenstein to discuss his new book, "Stay Calm," which applies his investment philosophy of staying calm during periods of market volatility, to navigating the uncertainties of life. He's on this week's episode of The David Rubenstein Show: Peer to Peer Conversations. This interview was recorded August 10 in New York. (Source: Bloomberg)
